stories.title: Breaking Bad's RJ Mitte dies at 34
stories.summary: RJ Mitte, who played Walter White Jr. on Breaking Bad and, like the character, had cerebral palsy, died by suicide at 34, TMZ reported. Dean Norris's "Oh my God! ... I am heartbroken" got 482K likes, the most of any post that day, and Bryan Cranston's tribute to "my sweet son on Breaking Bad" was shared everywhere. A resurfaced clip of Mitte describing how he was financially exploited at 17 spread alongside them, and his Wikipedia page drew 1.4 million views.
